title: Operator timesheet privacy
notes: Operators now load and display only their own timesheet entries.
The employee filter is hidden for operators; managers, admins, supervisors and accounting retain company-wide review access.
Timesheet summary metrics for operators are calculated only from their own entries.
Existing Supabase row-level security already restricts operators to timesheets.self.view; the UI now matches that database security model.
Added browser regression coverage to prevent operator timesheet visibility from leaking across employees.
